benefits.text: BBIA Last Auto Gel Eyeliner Slim eyeliner pencil gives precise lines with an ultra-fine 2mm tip. The soft, smooth gel formula gives a smooth line without breaking or clumping, suitable even for sensitive eyes. Excellent water and smudge resistance helps the line keep its color all day long.

howToUse.text:
Before use, apply a thin layer of powder to remove oil.
Twist up about 1-2mm each time you use it.
Fill in the gaps between the lashes, then connect them to create a complete line.
Close the cap tightly after use to prevent the pencil from drying out.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

positioning.text: Ultra-slim gel eyeliner pencil with a 2 mm tip that helps create precise, smooth and easy-to-control lines.

sellingPoints.text: Ultra-fine 2 mm tip; soft, smooth gel formula that does not break or clump; good water and smudge resistance.

texture.text: Twist-up gel eyeliner pencil, ultra-slim 2 mm tip, soft and smooth.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not claim absolute water/smudge resistance. On oily eyelids, it is still best to apply a thin layer of powder before lining for a more stable line.

finish.text: Fine line / soft yet defined / more natural than black.
